tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları online e-Visa alabilir veya Tanzanya havalimanlarında Kapıda Vize (VoA - 50$) alabilir. Zanzibar'a girişlerde zorunlu yerel seyahat sigortası kuralı vardır.

us.conditions: US citizens must obtain a multiple-entry tourist visa ($100 USD) either online or on arrival at major ports of entry.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens can obtain a single-entry tourist visa ($50 USD) online or on arrival.

gb.conditions: British passport holders can purchase a Visa on Arrival ($50) or apply for an eVisa before flying.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ получают визу по прибытии ($50) в аэропортах Дар-эс-Салама, Килиманджаро и Занзибара или оформляют e-Visa.

dos.title: Respect Stone Town Zanzibar modest dress code
dos.description: Zanzibar is over 95% Muslim; outside private resorts, cover shoulders and knees when walking through Stone Town.

dos.title: Carry US Dollar bills printed after 2013
dos.description: Tanzanian banks, safari parks, and hotels routinely reject US dollar banknotes printed prior to 2013.

dos.title: Get Zanzibar Inbound Insurance beforehand
dos.description: Mandatory Zanzibar government health insurance ($44) is required for tourists flying or boating into the island.

donts.title: Don't bring single-use plastic carrier bags
donts.description: Tanzania strictly bans importing plastic carrier bags; border officials will remove them at airport baggage screening.

donts.title: Don't photograph locals without permission
donts.description: Particularly in Maasai bomas and Zanzibar villages, ask politely and agree on photo fees if requested.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is customary on safari and Kilimanjaro climbs ($15-20 per day for safari guides; $10-15 per day for mountain porters).
